name: 状态屏 · 清洁屏幕与暂离防误触遮罩
description: 一键盖住全部显示器展示「清洁屏幕」「任务运行中 · 请勿触碰」「马上回来」或自定义告示，同时临时拦截键盘与滚轮防误触，按住 Esc 2 秒安全退出
author: Lumakey Official

commands.title: 进入「🧹 清洁屏幕与键盘」状态屏
commands.subtitle: 盖住全部屏幕并拦截键盘与鼠标滚轮输入，放心擦拭键盘或防宠物误踩

commands.title: 进入「⚡ 任务运行中 · 请勿触碰」状态屏
commands.subtitle: 开启防休眠常亮保护并盖上勿碰告示，适合跑长编译、备份或渲染任务

commands.title: 进入「☕ 马上回来」暂离状态屏
commands.subtitle: 暂时离开工位时展示暂离告示并拦截误触

commands.title: 使用自定义文案开启状态屏
commands.subtitle: 输入临时告示语（或使用插件设置中的默认自定义文案与表情）一键开启

commands.title: 立即退出状态屏保护
commands.subtitle: 关闭所有屏幕上的状态屏遮罩并恢复原有防休眠/静音状态

config.label: 开启状态屏时拦截键盘与滚轮输入（需宿主已授辅助功能权限）
状态屏期间自动保持防休眠常亮（退出后自动还原）
进入状态屏时自动静音（退出后自动还原）
按住 Esc 退出所需秒数
自定义状态主标题
config.placeholder: 例如：正在备份数据，请勿合盖

config.label: 自定义状态副标题
config.defaultValue: 后台任务执行中，稍后即回

en.name: Screen Shield · Clean Screen & Do-Not-Touch
en.description: Cover all displays with 'Cleaning Screen', 'Task Running · Do Not Touch', 'Be Right Back', or custom notices while blocking accidental keyboard/mouse touches (Hold Esc 2s to exit)

shield-clean.title: Activate '🧹 Cleaning Screen & Keyboard' Shield
shield-clean.subtitle: Cover displays and block accidental key presses while wiping screen or keyboard

shield-busy.title: Activate '⚡ Task Running · Do Not Touch' Shield
shield-busy.subtitle: Keep Mac awake and display a fullscreen do-not-disturb notice

shield-brb.title: Activate '☕ Be Right Back' Shield
shield-brb.subtitle: Show an away banner across all screens while stepping away

shield-custom.title: Activate Custom Message Status Screen
shield-custom.subtitle: Pass a one-off banner message or use your saved custom preset

shield-dismiss.title: Dismiss Active Status Screen
shield-dismiss.subtitle: Close all status screen overlays and restore previous sleep/audio state

blockInput.label: Block keyboard & scroll input while shield is active (requires Accessibility)

keepAwake.label: Keep Mac awake while shield is active (restores on exit)

muteAudio.label: Mute system audio while shield is active (restores on exit)

holdSeconds.label: Seconds to hold Esc to exit
